description: This file defines a PHP class 'database' which acts as a wrapper around the ADODB database abstraction layer. It provides methods for connecting to various database types, executing queries, fetching results in different formats, and managing database schema operations specific to the TestLink project. The file includes license and metadata comments, along with helper functions for query logging, error handling, and performance measurement.

classes.name: database
classes.description: A wrapper class for managing database connections, executing queries, and fetching results, specifically designed for the TestLink project with support for multiple database types and detailed logging.

methods.name: microtime_float
methods.description: Returns the current Unix timestamp with microsecond precision.

methods.name: setLogEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables query logging.

methods.name: getLogEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether logging is enabled.

methods.name: setLogQueries
methods.description: Enables or disables query execution logging.

methods.name: getLogQueries
methods.description: Returns whether query logging is enabled.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new database connection object with the specified database type, setting up the ADODB connection.

methods.name: get_dbmgr_object
methods.description: Returns the underlying ADODB database object.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using provided DSN or parameters.

methods.name: exec_query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with optional limit and offset, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: fetch_array
methods.description: Fetches a row from the query result as an associative array, handling different database driver formats.

methods.name: db_result
methods.description: Retrieves a specific row or value from a result set.

methods.name: insert_id
methods.description: Returns the ID of the last inserted row, supporting PostgreSQL and Oracle sequences.

methods.name: db_is_pgsql
methods.description: Checks if the database type is PostgreSQL.

methods.name: db_is_oracle
methods.description: Checks if the database type is Oracle.

methods.name: db_table_exists
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the database.

methods.name: db_field_exists
methods.description: Checks if a field exists in a table.

methods.name: key_exists_on_field
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists on a table field (MySQL only).

methods.name: prepare_string
methods.description: Escapes and prepares a string for database insertion.

methods.name: prepare_int
methods.description: Prepares an integer for database insertion.

methods.name: prepare_bool
methods.description: Prepares a boolean for database insertion.

methods.name: db_now
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp suitable for the database.

methods.name: db_timestamp
methods.description: Generates a timestamp for a specific date or current time.

methods.name: db_unixtimestamp
methods.description: Converts a date into a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: count_queries
methods.description: Returns the total number of executed queries.

methods.name: count_unique_queries
methods.description: Returns the number of unique queries executed.

methods.name: time_queries
methods.description: Returns total time spent executing queries.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: error_num
methods.description: Returns the last database error number.

methods.name: error_msg
methods.description: Returns the last database error message.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns a string combining error number and message, optionally with the query.

methods.name: num_rows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a result set.

methods.name: affected_rows
methods.description: Returns the number of affected rows from the last operation.

methods.name: fetchFirstRowSingleColumn
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement and returns the value of a specific column from the first row.

methods.name: fetchFirstRow
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement and returns the first row as an associative array.

methods.name: fetchOneValue
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement and returns a single scalar value from the first row.

methods.name: fetchColumnsIntoArray
methods.description: Returns an array of values from a specific column across result rows.

methods.name: fetchRowsIntoMap
methods.description: Returns a map of row data keyed by a specific column.

methods.name: fetchRowsIntoMapAddRC
methods.description: Returns a map of row data with record counts, keyed by a specific column.

methods.name: fetchMapRowsIntoMapStackOnCol
methods.description: Returns a nested map of rows, stacking data on a specific column.

methods.name: build_sql_create_db
methods.description: Generates SQL statements for creating a database for different DBMS.

methods.name: db_null_timestamp
methods.description: Returns a null timestamp value for the database.

methods.name: fetchRowsIntoMap2l
methods.description: Returns a nested map of rows with two levels of keys.

methods.name: fetchRowsIntoMap3l
methods.description: Returns a nested map of rows with three levels of keys.

methods.name: fetchRowsIntoMap4l
methods.description: Returns a nested map of rows with four levels of keys.

methods.name: fetchRowsIntoMapAddRC
methods.description: Returns a map of rows with accumulated record counts.

methods.name: fetchMapRowsIntoMapStackOnCol
methods.description: Returns a nested map of rows, stacking data on specified columns.
